title: ID0391100-DC/Si-D/SE [Y2/S5 313649569001] OCPP offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
OCPP offline. Reboot doesn't help.  Please ssh into the charger and check the router.
Root cause: Settings was changed to 3g
Solution: Changed the Service mode via SSH (3G to 4G LTE) fixed the problem
Warranty status: Active
